attributes.name: Staff of Curses
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card and discard a spell to decrease the difficulty of a combat check by 2d4, or by 1d4+4 if you have the Arcane skill.

When a character at your location encounters a non-villain, non-henchman monster from a location deck, reveal this card and discard a spell to exchange that monster with one from the box.

Discard this card and a spell to banish a card that has the Curse trait displayed next to the deck of a character at your location.
